title: Toussaint as arranger and producer, drawing out limited singers
summary: Matassa praises Toussaint's ability to build arrangements around artists like Chris Kenner and describes how he worked in the studio.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made
